parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
The end date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The default value is the current day.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
The start date of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

You can query data only from the last 90 days. StartDate must be greater than or equal to `Now - 90`.
